trusted_assumptions: The lower contract for Box::into_raw_with_allocator preserves ownership and the abstract allocation token.
axiom_box_slice_token_view: a boxed slice's raw allocation token denotes its sequence view.
axiom_box_slice_into_vec_parts: thinning a Box-produced slice pointer with matching length yields valid Vec parts with the same contents.
The lower contract for Vec::from_raw_parts_in constructs a Vec whose view is the valid raw buffer view.
The vstd slice-length specification relates b.len() to b@.len().
rationale: Copies Rust 1.96's len, into_raw_with_allocator, and from_raw_parts_in control flow; the result follows compositionally using explicit raw-representation bridges.
